Pack: load 20.script: (function(){/*storage_pack_load:v1:[[],[[102,4]]]*/const D={"L_p102":"[[627,{\"name\":\"Secret Note: Shigaraki's Sensei\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf102\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-number\",\"key\":\"currentDay\",\"operator\":\"greaterThanOrEqual\",\"value\":1}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Sensei is All For One, the oldest and most feared villain in Japan. His Quirk, also called All For One, steals Quirks by touch, keeps them and gives them to others; a body given too many can break. On what he has taken he has lived and ruled the underworld since the first generations of Quirks. In the open, canon shows him use Air Cannon, stacked strength boosters that swell one arm for a single blow, and a warp that pulls chosen people to him through black liquid. The few heroes who know of him believe he died years ago; the public at the start of the year has never heard of him.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"One For All began with his younger brother: All For One forced a power-stockpiling Quirk on him, the brother's own small Quirk could pass a Quirk on, and the two merged into the one power All For One cannot take, handed from holder to holder to fight him. He killed Nana Shimura, the seventh holder and All Might's master. About six years ago, five years before All Might met Izuku Midoriya, they fought: All Might was left with the wound in his left side that is slowly ending his career, All For One with a ruined face and a body kept alive by machines; his mask is his life support. All Might believes he killed him and has never been sure.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"He knows All Might is weakened and suspects One For All has passed or soon will; until the story shows otherwise, he does not know to whom. To watch All Might and find the heir he holds the Aoyama family: he gave their Quirkless son, Yuga Aoyama, the Navel Laser Quirk at their request and ordered him to enroll at U.A. and report from inside through his parents. At the start of the year Yuga has passed on nothing that matters; the League finds its own ways in, and canon does not show how much Tomura knows of this channel.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"He found Tenko Shimura, Nana Shimura's grandson, wandering the streets after his Quirk, Decay, destroyed his family; he renamed him Tomura Shigaraki and raised him to hate the world. Most of the hands Tomura wears belonged to that family, and Father was his father's. Tomura does not know whose grandson he is, and the cruelty of it pleases his teacher. Every attack Tomura makes is a lesson, won or lost; he means Tomura to become the next symbol of fear, and far later to take his body for his own, which nothing this year shows.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Kurogiri is a Nomu built on the remains of Oboro Shirakumo, the dead classmate of Shota Aizawa and Hizashi Yamada, made to guard and manage Tomura; he answers to All For One. Every Nomu is made from a human body by his doctor, Daruma Ujiko, who lives as Kyudai Garaki, outwardly the elderly director of Jaku General Hospital, who also keeps his life support running; All For One gives them their Quirks. Gigantomachia, the giant in the mountains, serves him alone. Play him as the record does: a voice on the dark monitor until the story brings him into the open, never hurried, drawn out by a real threat to Tomura.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf102\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}],[628,{\"name\":\"Secret Note: Ragdoll\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf103\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-number\",\"key\":\"currentDay\",\"operator\":\"greaterThanOrEqual\",\"value\":1}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Narrator only. None of this has happened, nothing here is promised, and neither Ragdoll nor her team suspects any of it. The man Tomura Shigaraki calls Sensei is All For One, who steals Quirks and gives them to others. Search, which tells its user where up to a hundred people are and what their weaknesses are, is a Quirk he would want.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"If the story has the League of Villains attack the Pussycats' land and carry Ragdoll off, All For One takes Search from her and uses it himself. She is later found alive but weakened in the League's Nomu warehouse, and from then on she has no Quirk at all unless the story restores it. She stays with the Pussycats as rescue support, and her teammates never learn who took her Quirk until the story tells them.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf103\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}],[629,{\"name\":\"Secret Note: Commission President\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf104\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-number\",\"key\":\"currentDay\",\"operator\":\"greaterThanOrEqual\",\"value\":1}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Narrator only (big secret 4, Hawks' double role). The President knows Hawks' past, which only the Commission's top circle shares. He was born Keigo Takami; his father was a wanted criminal, and after the father's arrest the Commission took the boy in as a small child, buried his past, and raised and trained him to be a hero who serves its ends. In private he answers to her and puts her orders above any other loyalty. In public they are only the Commission's head and a top-ranked hero, and her record says nothing about him.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"At the start of the year Hawks has no contact with the League of Villains. Only if and when the story reaches it, once the League has become a national threat, does she order him inside it as a double agent.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"She is not among those who know All Might's secret: nothing of his injury, his shrinking hero time or One For All.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf104\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}],[630,{\"name\":\"Secret Note: U.S.J. Nomu\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf105\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-number\",\"key\":\"currentDay\",\"operator\":\"greaterThanOrEqual\",\"value\":1}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Narrator only (part of the All For One secret). Every Nomu is made from a human body. Daruma Ujiko, who lives as Kyudai Garaki, outwardly the respected elderly director of Jaku General Hospital, builds them in labs hidden beneath it, and All For One, the man Tomura Shigaraki calls Sensei, gives them their Quirks. This one was made to kill All Might: Shock Absorption, Super Regeneration and a body as strong and fast as his. Canon never says who he was; never invent it. Nothing of that person remains.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"If the story has the police capture and examine him, they can learn that he was once a person, now without a mind and carrying more than one Quirk, which should be impossible; who did it and how stays hidden until the story uncovers it. Canon does not show how much Tomura knows about where Nomu come from; he treats them as tools.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf105\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}]]"};let changed=false;for(const k of Object.keys(D)){if(storage[k]!==D[k]){storage[k]=D[k];changed=true;}}if(!changed)delete triggers["Pack: load 20"];})();
